description: [Procurement] Find open or upcoming EU grant calls that fit a company's or project's topic. Use when scouting Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, LIFE, CEF, EU4Health or similar funding. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/eu-grants

min_days_to_deadline.description: Only calls whose deadline is at least N days away (default 0)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: search_eu_grants
title: EU Funding Calls Search (Funding & Tenders Portal) ($0.02)
